answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The velvet of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. A crystal of per-task receipts records who did what, and the cipher of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
